identity_assessment.limitation: The dataset exposes only image and label. Filenames and row indices can support stable image-level IDs, but no verified product, SKU, or manufacturer identity exists.

leakage_risks: Raw train/validation/test retrieval metrics are at risk of leakage when exact or visually near-identical images cross splits.
Filename source-stem matches are heuristic evidence only and cannot prove physical-product identity.
A query that is itself present in the catalogue would measure lookup, not generalization to a new photograph.
